buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the

original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses *Bidder must submit the seal and signed copy of tender documents alo ng with required annexure and supporting documents. Qualifying Requirement: QR1. The bidder should be either a manufacturer of minimum rating of 6.6kV, 1200A Vacu um Circuit Breakers with short circuit breaking current rating of 32KA or higher. OR The bidder should be an Authorized representative of manufacturer meeting manufa cturers requirements of minimum rating of 6.6kV, 1200A Vacuum Circuit Breakers wit h short circuit breaking current rating of 32KA or higher specifically authorized by the manufacturer for this tender. QR2. The bidder should have executed orders for supply of 6.6kV Vacuum Circuit Breakers ” to any PSU/Central Government/State Government/Steel Industry/Power Plant/ any other process industries in India during the financial years from FY 2019-20 to FY 202 5-26 (both inclusive) in any of the following manner: a) Single Order with executed value not less than INR 148.00 Lakhs OR b) Two (2) Orders with executed value not less than INR 93.00 Lakhs each OR c) Three (3) Orders with executed value not less than INR 74.00 Lakhs each Note: - Reference work executed by the bidder as a sub-contractor may also be considered, provided the certificate issued by main contractor is duly certified by the Principal E mployer specifying the scope of work executed by the bidder. - The word “executed” means the bidder should have completed the work equivalent to the amount as specified in QR2, even though the total contract(s) is partially exe cuted, not completed / not closed.

- In case of contract (s) is /are under execution as on last date of FY 2025-26 , the val ue of work executed till such date will be considered provided the principal employe r certifies the same. - All values mentioned above are excluding applicable taxes. QR3. The average annual turnover of the bidder in the preceding 03 (Three) financial years , i.e. financial years FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26 shall not be less tha n INR 185.00 Lakhs. Note: - Other income shall not be considered while computing annual turnover. In case the audited financial results for the last financial year are not available, financ ial results certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant shall be considered. If such certification is also not available, the audited results of the three consecutive financia l years preceding the last financial year shall be considered for evaluation. In such ca ses, a certificate from the CEO/CFO, as per the prescribed format enclosed in the bid ding documents, shall be submitted confirming that the latest financial results are un der audit and the Certificate from the practicing Chartered Accountant certifying the financial parameters is not available. QR4. The bidder should have valid - PAN, GST and EPFO registration. Notwithstanding anything stated above, RGPPL reserves the right to assess the capa bilities and capacity of the bidder to perform the contract, should the circumstances warrant such assessment in the overall interest of RGPPL. Documents required A. In Support of QR1:

a) For Manufacturer: Factory License / Third-party Certification / Product Data She et / Technical Manual /NSIC certificate/ MSME Registration certificate/ any other statutory document as a proof of being manufacturer. b) For Authorized Representative of Manufacturer: Tender-specific Authorization L etter issued by the Manufacturer (QR criteria for manufacturer: Factory License / Third-party Certification / Product Data Sheet / Technical Manual /NSIC certificat e/ MSME Registration certificate/ any other statutory document as a proof of bei ng manufacturer). B. In Support of QR2: a. Copies of Purchase Order / Award Letter / Work Order/Agreement copies to be submitted along with Completion Certificate / any other document clearly esta blishing scope of supply / work, value of executed work and completion period. b. Certificate from Client as described under notes of QR2 shall also be provided wherever required. C. In Support of QR3 a. Copies of audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account Statement with U DIN number confirming the turnover for preceding three financial years shall b e submitted. b. Certificate from practicing Chartered Accountant or CEO/CFO as described un der notes of QR3 shall also be provided wherever required. D. In Support of QR4: Copy of Valid- PAN Card, GST Registration Certificate, EPFO. .
